a = input().split()
n = int(a[0])
k = int(a[1])
b = list(map(int, input().split()))
if (k >= 3):
	print(max(b))
elif (k == 1):
	print(min(b))
else:
	maxo = -10000000000
	for i in range(1,n-1):
		b1 = b[:i]
		b2 = b[i+1:n]
		m1 = min(b1)
		m2 = min(b2)
		ma = max(m1, m2)
		if (ma > maxo):
			 maxo = ma
	print(maxo)
